# Sellico

> Sellico is a Russian web-based operating system for sellers and teams managing stores on Wildberries, Ozon, and Yandex Market.

Last updated: 2026-09-22

Canonical domain: [sellico.ru](https://sellico.ru/)

The product combines marketplace finance and unit economics, inventory and supply planning, advertising, product-card SEO, reviews, incoming requests, and team tasks in one workspace.

Canonical HTML pages are the primary source. The Markdown and llms files are alternative machine-readable summaries and do not replace the canonical pages.

## Supported marketplaces

- Wildberries
- Ozon
- Yandex Market

## Main capabilities

- Revenue, expenses, profit, margin, and unit economics by SKU
- Inventory, product, and supply planning
- Advertising, pricing, and performance control
- SEO audit and AI-assisted product descriptions
- Review and incoming-request workflows
- Tasks, calendar, chat, and team coordination

Availability and limits depend on the selected plan.

Sellico supports only the capabilities documented on the canonical pages above. Model scenarios shown on the website are illustrative and are not customer testimonials or guaranteed results.

## Pricing

- Start: 3,000 RUB per month
- Pro: 8,000 RUB per month
- Business: 15,000 RUB per month
- Enterprise: from 40,000 RUB per month

Plans include a 3-day free period without a bank card. The first store can usually be connected in about 15 minutes. Exact limits: [pricing page](https://sellico.ru/pricing/).
